name: 48ya Monogatari
source: Silky's debut work. It consists of 48 situations on which you can get to know 48 different girls, and ask them about their dreams, hobbies, favorite food, or sexual experience for that matter. At the end of every situation you will have the chance to find out what could be the favorite position of the girl in question, and get a reward if you do hit the mark.
translation: Silky的出道作品。它由48个场景组成，你可以在其中认识48个不同的女孩，并询问她们的梦想、爱好、最喜欢的食物或性经历。在每种情况结束时，你将有机会找出有关女孩最喜欢的位置，如果你达到目标，你将获得奖励。
